title: Poll control DB while paused
notes: Added clear_control(run_id) method to ControllerDB to acknowledge/clear consumed control requests.

Updated QAController.run_loop() so that while in PAUSED state (and WAITING_FOR_CODEX), the controller continuously polls controller_db for 'resume' or 'stop' control actions, immediately consumes/clears the control request upon receipt, and transitions appropriately.
